entities.name: Daria
entities.description: A character who laughs that history books will now mention her.

entities.name: Gerrard
entities.description: A Weatherlight crew member who rallies others to fight.

entities.name: Commodore Guff
entities.description: A character who enjoys a good joke.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A planeswalker, four thousand years old, who plans for betrayal.

entities.name: Szat
entities.description: A figure who betrayed Urza and advises Darigaaz to rule through fear.

entities.name: Ertai
entities.description: A wizard altered by Phyrexian science who taunts Gerrard.

entities.name: Bo Levar
entities.description: A planeswalker who contradicts Urza.

entities.name: Lord Dralnu
entities.description: A lord of the undead who confers with Death.

entities.name: Grizzlegom
entities.description: A character who objects to undead allies.

entities.name: Agnate
entities.description: A metathran trained to battle in three dimensions.

entities.name: Crosis
entities.description: A dragon whose roar ended a battle and began a slaughter.

entities.name: Darigaaz
entities.description: A dragon who gave his life defending Dominaria, like his mother.

entities.name: Rith
entities.description: A dragon addressed by Darigaaz.

entities.name: Tahngarth
entities.description: A Weatherlight crew member.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: Captain of the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: A maro-sorcerer aided by the Heart of Yavimaya.

entities.name: Molimo
entities.description: A maro-sorcerer.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: A figure who strengthens her faithful and speaks to Eladamri.

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: An elf leader whose summons ended tribal rivalries.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: A figure who torments Ertai for Yawgmoth.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: The Phyrexian ruler of a realm, whose vision Phyrexians die for.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's brother, whom Urza thinks he sees in Yawgmoth's realm.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders who want to remake Dominaria.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane being invaded and remade.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: A plane that stole Dominaria from under the feet of its defenders.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The home of the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Predator
entities.description: A ship Sisay crashed into Crovax's stronghold.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: A forest with a Heart.

events.summary: Urza states he counted on Szat's betrayal.
events.quote: Did I know Szat would betray us?

events.summary: Ertai taunts Gerrard about the crew's rescue.
events.quote: I'm sure the crew will come to your rescue as quickly as they came to mine.

events.summary: Nine planeswalkers seek the annihilation of Phyrexia to save Dominaria.
events.quote: To save Dominaria, nine planeswalkers sought the annihilation of Phyrexia itself.

events.summary: Darigaaz dies defending Dominaria from the tyranny of self-styled gods.
events.quote: Darigaaz gave his life defending Dominaria from the tyranny of self-styled "gods."

events.summary: Sisay crashes the Predator into Crovax's stronghold.
events.quote: I just sent the *Predator* crashing into his stronghold.

events.summary: Urza sees a vision of Mishra deep in Yawgmoth's realm.
events.quote: Deep in Yawgmoth's realm, Urza stopped dead in his tracks and rubbed his soot-filled eyes. "Mishra?"

events.summary: Eladamri's summons brings tribes to lay aside rivalries.
events.quote: Tribal rivalries and petty disputes were laid aside at Eladamri's summons.

events.summary: Freyalise shows Eladamri that his Skyshroud home has followed him to Dominaria.
events.quote: "Your Skyshroud home has followed you to Dominaria."

events.summary: Crovax tells Ertai he will kill him a hundred times a day as Yawgmoth's reward.
events.quote: I shall kill him a hundred times a day.

events.summary: Multani observes Rath's overlay interfering with the Aether.
events.quote: Rath's overlay is interfering with the Æther itself.

events.summary: Darigaaz declares sacrificing mortal dragons must end.
events.quote: Sacrificing mortal dragons to satisfy your immortal hunger ends here.

events.summary: Crosis roars, ending the battle and beginning the slaughter.
events.quote: When Crosis roared, the battle ended and the slaughter began.

relations.note: Urza addresses Gerrard about Yawgmoth's glory
relations.quote: Before the glory of Yawgmoth, yes, even this makes sense.
